goal.en: Report two patient cases correctly (temperature / pulse, beds 3 and 5).
goal.fr: Rapporter correctement deux cas (Température / Pouls, lits 3 et 5).
goal.ar: نقل حالتين بدقة (درجة الحرارة / النبض، السرير ٣ والسرير ٥).

segments.en: Lina is a medical student.
segments.fr: Lina est étudiant·e en médecine.

segments.en: It is the morning shift.
segments.fr: C'est la garde du matin.

segments.en: The patient in bed 3 has a temperature.
segments.fr: Le patient du lit 3 a Température.

segments.en: The patient in bed 5 has a pulse.
segments.fr: Le patient du lit 5 a Pouls.

segments.en: The patient in bed 5 does not have a temperature.
segments.fr: Le patient du lit 5 n'a pas de Température.
segments.ar: مريض السرير ٥ ليس عنده درجة الحرارة.

segments.en: Lina reports the two cases to the doctor.
segments.fr: Lina rapporte les deux cas au médecin.

questions.q: Which patient is in bed 3?
questions.model: The patient in bed 3 has a temperature.

questions.q: What does the patient in bed 5 have?
Does the patient in bed 5 have temperature?
questions.qFr: Le patient du lit 5 a-t-il température ?
questions.qAr: هل عند مريض السرير ٥ درجة الحرارة؟
accepted: he does not have a temperature
questions.model: No, he does not have a temperature.

hint.en: Careful: bed 5 does NOT have temperature — that is bed 3.
hint.fr: Attention : le lit 5 n'a PAS température — c'est le lit 3.
hint.ar: انتبه: السرير ٥ ليس عنده درجة الحرارة — ذلك السرير ٣.

questions.q: How many cases does the student report?
Who reports the cases?

explain.en: One patient: reports/has/does. Two patients: report/have/do.
explain.fr: Un patient : reports/has/does. Deux patients : report/have/do.
explain.ar: مريض واحد: reports/has/does. مريضان: report/have/do.

items.prompt: The patient in bed 3 … the case. (report — présent)
items.model: The patient in bed 3 reports the case.

items.prompt: The patients … a temperature and a pulse. (have)
items.model: The patients have a temperature and a pulse.

items.prompt: The patient in bed 5 … not have a temperature. (do)
items.model: The patient in bed 5 does not have a temperature.

prompt.en: Report the two cases to the doctor, in two sentences.
prompt.fr: Rapporte les deux cas au médecin, en deux phrases.

retell.model: The patient in bed 3 has a temperature. The patient in bed 5 has a pulse.

context.en: Evening shift: the patient in bed 7 has a blood pressure. The patient in bed 9 has a temperature. The patient in bed 9 does not have a pulse.
context.fr: Garde du soir : le lit 7 a Tension artérielle, le lit 9 a Température et n'a pas Pouls.
context.ar: مناوبة المساء: السرير ٧ عنده ضغط الدم، والسرير ٩ عنده درجة الحرارة وليس عنده النبض.

questions.q: What does the patient in bed 7 have?
Does the patient in bed 9 have pulse?
questions.qFr: Le patient du lit 9 a-t-il pouls ?
accepted: he does not have a pulse
questions.model: No, he does not have a pulse.

hint.en: Careful: bed 9 does NOT have pulse.
hint.fr: Attention : le lit 9 n'a PAS pouls.
hint.ar: انتبه: السرير ٩ ليس عنده النبض.

prompt.en: Report the evening cases, in two sentences.
prompt.fr: Rapporte les cas du soir, en deux phrases.

task.model: The patient in bed 7 has a blood pressure. The patient in bed 9 has a temperature.
